data.one_liner: Wrap sync and async functions as callable Command objects with reactive state.
data.what_it_does: Wraps synchronous or asynchronous functions into callable Command objects. It automatically exposes execution state like running, errors, and results as ValueListenables for easy reactive UI integration.
use_when: You want automatic loading states and error handling for async operations without boilerplate try/catch blocks.
You want to prevent parallel executions of the same action natively.
You want a lightweight alternative to heavier state management frameworks.
avoid_when: You need complex event-driven BLoC patterns or heavily structured architectural models.
You rely entirely on non-ValueListenable state providers.
strengths: Eliminates manual try/catch and loading state boilerplate.
Integrates seamlessly with ValueListenable and watch_it.
weaknesses: Requires learning the Command pattern paradigm.
Circular pipes can cause infinite loops if not carefully constructed.
data.setup_notes: Requires listen_it as a dependency. No native configuration or code generation needed.
